claim.why_it_matters: The statement heading is plain paragraph text, not a heading, so a heading-based index of the Communication module has no ENABLE statement section.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page (XIV-20) opens its boxed level-2 region with the section title '3.3 THE ENABLE STATEMENT', the statement's section heading. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md (line 25381) it appears as the plain paragraph '║3.3 THE ENABLE STATEMENT║' with no '#' marker. The sibling statements in the same module are headings: line 25295 '### 3.1 THE ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT STATEMENT' and line 25323 '## ║3.2 THE DISABLE STATEMENT║'. The ║ markers correctly show the level-2 box, so the text and box are present; only heading markup is missing. The defect is structural and does not change meaning. The 3.1 and 3.2 headings also use different levels (### and ##), but that is outside this claim.
